انتحرن (form VIII)
# اِنْتَحَرْنَ (intaḥarna) /in.ta.ħar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
# اُنْتُحِرْنَ (untuḥirna) /un.tu.ħir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
# اِنْتَحِرْنَ (intaḥirna) /in.ta.ħir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
